amendments.rule: No owner freeze act is required. prepare derives a content-addressed epoch from the committed bundle, this overlay, the runner, the host tool, dependency and environment manifests, the candidate models and the input manifests. Any byte change produces a different epoch.
prepare writes the epoch packet, the epoch replay plan and all 75 scheduled-slot and scheduled-execution identities before the first execution.

Case records use logical_slot_ordinal, add execution_ordinal, identities.scheduled_execution_sha256 and verdict_conditions, and name byte digests raw_sha256. The bundle record_contract lists the closed field sets.
Adapter requests carry repetition-invariant coordinates only, so the three repetitions of a slot receive identical bytes and their outputs are comparable.
Records carry contributor-produced, unreviewed labels. No record claims owner review or independent review.
One candidate-neutral adapter serves all five candidates, so no path is candidate-local. Any adapter or runner change is a shared change and starts a new epoch for every candidate.
No selection or tie-break rule exists in this epoch. A rule written after results exist never chooses among candidates in the same epoch; it can apply only to a later epoch.
Resource ceilings cover the whole process tree through per-execution memory and pids cgroups. A missing, unreadable or zero measurement fails the epoch closed.
